title: Psychic Terrain

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Aura Sphere, Focus Blast, Hex, Hidden Power Water, Magical Leaf, Mind Blown, Moonblast, Mystical Fire, and Secret Power: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Psychic-type.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Anticipation or Forewarn: Special Attack +2 when it enters.
Mind's Eye: Special Attack +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Special Attack +2 and becomes confused.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
